day_shape: 71 items: White House renews Iran national emergency, US sanctions three over MANPADS procurement, FT reports Russia-Iran deal for 90 missile launchers, Reza'i delivers Khamenei message to Putin in Moscow, IRGC claims fifth and sixth US drones downed over Qeshm, and heavy regime messaging on Republican midterm losses.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear diplomacy via Doha
threads.summary: Iran submitted a new nuclear proposal to Washington and is reviewing mediator proposals in Doha talks, per NYT and Iran International reporting. Vice President JD Vance blamed the Iran war for Republican midterm losses as Trump weighs strikes or a settlement.

threads.label: Russia-Iran military and diplomatic track
threads.summary: Khamenei's office said SNSC Secretary Mohsen Reza'i delivered the Supreme Leader's message to Putin in Moscow, discussing regional issues. The Financial Times reported Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 helicopter-mounted precision-missile launchers, and the US sanctioned three over Iranian MANPADS procurement.

threads.label: US sanctions posture and emergency renewal
threads.summary: The White House published continuation of the national emergency with respect to Iran in the Federal Register. The US sanctioned three individuals linked to Iranian MANPADS procurement, and the State Department condemned Iran's execution of three protesters detained in January.

threads.label: IRGC drone-downing claims over Qeshm
threads.summary: IRGC Public Relations claimed via Defa Press and IRIB that fifth and sixth US MQM-170 reconnaissance drones were downed over Qeshm Island using electronic warfare systems. A senior IRGC Aerospace adviser told Al-Aalam that any country assisting US aggression would become a legitimate target.

threads.label: Regime messaging on US midterm losses
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that American power faces "irreversible collapse," and IRIB amplified claims including a $2 trillion S&P 500 drop, Rubio weighing resignation, and Hegseth's position shaken. Iran International reported state TV aired a live mock hanging of Trump.

threads.label: IDF Lebanon operations and Hezbollah weapons
threads.summary: The IDF said troops operating in the Beaufort Ridge and Litani River areas located over 340 Hezbollah weapons including RPGs, anti-tank missiles and a ~7m underground shaft inside a civilian home. The Jerusalem Post amplified the operational update.

threads.label: Yemen-Saudi exchanges and regional ties
threads.summary: Defa Press relayed Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree's claim of 61 Saudi strikes on Yemen in 24 hours and a Houthi drone attack on King Fahd International Airport. Jerusalem Post reported Saudi Arabia and Syria signed military and financial agreements, and tightened Houthi port financial controls.
